segments.an4.186:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an4.186:1.2: “kena nu kho, bhante, loko nīyati, kena loko parikassati, kassa ca uppannassa vasaṃ gacchatī”ti?
segments.an4.186:2.2: Bhaddako kho te, bhikkhu, ummaggo [ummaṅgo (syā. ka.)], bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī [kalyāṇā (ka.)] paripucchā.
segments.an4.186:2.4: ‘kena nu kho, bhante, loko nīyati, kena loko parikassati, kassa ca uppannassa vasaṃ gacchatī’”ti?
segments.an4.186:2.6: “Cittena kho, bhikkhu, loko nīyati, cittena parikassati, cittassa uppannassa vasaṃ gacchatī”ti.
segments.an4.186:3.1: “Sādhu, bhante”ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttari pañhaṃ apucchi –
segments.an4.186:3.3: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, bahussuto dhammadharo hotī”ti?
segments.an4.186:4.2: Bhaddako kho te, bhikkhu ummaggo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
segments.an4.186:4.5: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, bahussuto dhammadharo hotī’”ti?
segments.an4.186:4.7: “Bahū kho, bhikkhu, mayā dhammā desitā [bahu kho bhikkhu mayā dhammo desito (ka.)]–
segments.an4.186:4.8: suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthā, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
segments.an4.186:4.9: Catuppadāya cepi, bhikkhu, gāthāya atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammappaṭipanno hoti bahussuto dhammadharoti alaṃ vacanāyā”ti.
segments.an4.186:5.1: “Sādhu, bhante”ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttari pañhaṃ apucchi –
segments.an4.186:5.3: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, sutavā nibbedhikapañño hotī”ti?
segments.an4.186:6.2: Bhaddako kho te, bhikkhu, ummaggo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
segments.an4.186:6.5: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, sutavā nibbedhikapañño hotī’”ti?
segments.an4.186:6.7: “Idha, bhikkhu, bhikkhuno ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti sutaṃ hoti, paññāya cassa atthaṃ ativijjha passati;
segments.an4.186:6.8: ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti sutaṃ hoti, paññāya cassa atthaṃ ativijjha passati;
segments.an4.186:6.9: ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti sutaṃ hoti, paññāya cassa atthaṃ ativijjha passati;
segments.an4.186:6.10: ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti sutaṃ hoti, paññāya cassa atthaṃ ativijjha passati.
segments.an4.186:6.11: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, sutavā nibbedhikapañño hotī”ti.
segments.an4.186:7.1: “Sādhu, bhante”ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttari pañhaṃ apucchi –
segments.an4.186:7.3: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, paṇḍito mahāpañño hotī”ti?
segments.an4.186:8.2: Bhaddako kho te, bhikkhu, ummaggo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
segments.an4.186:8.5: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, paṇḍito mahāpañño hotī’”ti?
segments.an4.186:8.7: “Idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño nevattabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahitaparahitaubhayahitasabbalokahitameva cintayamāno cinteti.
segments.an4.186:8.8: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño hotī”ti.

lines: Paññā eva vā ummujjanaṭṭhena ummaggoti vuccati.
Cittassa uppannassa vasaṃ gacchatīti ye cittassa vasaṃ gacchanti, tesaṃyevettha gahaṇaṃ veditabbaṃ.
Dhammānudhammappaṭipanno hotīti lokuttaradhammassa anucchavikadhammaṃ saha sīlena pubbabhāgappaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti.
Idaṃ dukkhanti ṭhapetvā taṇhaṃ sesaṃ tebhūmakakkhandhapañcakaṃ dukkhanti sutaṃ hoti.
Ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti vaṭṭamūlakataṇhā tassa dukkhassa samudayoti sutaṃ hoti.
Chaṭṭhe ākaḍḍhīyatīti cittavasiko loko tattha tattha upakaḍḍhīyati.
Tesaṃyevettha gahaṇaṃ veditabbanti ye apariññātavatthukā cittassa vasaṃ gacchanti, tesaṃyeva gahaṇaṃ.
Na hi pariññātakkhandhā pahīnakilesā cittassa vasaṃ gacchanti, cittaṃ pana attano vase vattenti.
Pubbabhāgapaṭipadanti dhutaṅgamādiṃ katvā yāva gotrabhuñāṇaṃ, tāva pavattetabbaṃ samathavipassanāsaṅkhātaṃ sammāpaṭipadaṃ.
